snippet.title: Duet Night Abyss | Train to the Snowfield Departs - Siver Torrent, Rising Star Version Trailer
snippet.description:
Upon the desolate frozen expanse, iron skeletons lie in deep slumber; 
Within the thick mist, the train's whistle hardens into frost. 
Is this an express speeding toward a long-lost home, 
Or a rushing cage that knows no end?

As the roar of steam shatters the silence of Icelake City, 
The rails of destiny forge ahead, between frozen earth and tender sprouts— 
The train to the snowfield has departed.

Silver Torrent, Rising Star will officially launch on June 2.
